register.labelZh: STRIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 你可以用 strip away、strip off 和 strip from 談論移除油漆、牆紙、貼紙和其他覆蓋物。；strip down 可以描述拆開機器;strip out 則可以描述拆除房間、車輛或建築物內的設備。；strip off 表示脫去衣服;strip down to something 則能說明最後剩下甚麼衣物。；strip somebody or something of something 可以表示某人的重要職位、獎項、權利或財物被奪去。
register.summaryEn: You can use strip away, strip off and strip from when talking about paint, wallpaper, stickers and other coverings. Strip down describes taking a machine apart, while strip out describes removing things from inside a room, vehicle or building. Strip off describes taking clothes off. Strip down to something tells the listener what clothing remains. Strip somebody or something of something can express that an important position, award, right or possession has been taken away.
